note: Copy for the day 1 morning slice only. Written by Content Writer. Not read by the game yet: Game Dev to wire it in. Effect numbers stay in activities.csv and twists.json; nothing here changes balance. 'move' is the on-screen motion cue for that tap, 'caption' is the one-line text shown, 'sound' is optional.

goal.text: Get to your 9:00 lecture on time.
goal.hint: Eat something, find the bus, make it to campus.

steps.title: Rise and shine, sort of
steps.caption: O Block, 07:00. Your phone buzzes on the pillow. Your stomach buzzes louder.
steps.move: Blanket slides off, character sits up, sunlight stripe crosses the floor.

steps.caption: Four steps to the kitchenette. It is a small room and a long walk.
steps.move: Character walks across the room to the kettle, slippers squeak, roommate's bed shape rises and falls.

steps.caption: The kettle clicks on and starts to mutter.
steps.move: Kettle light glows orange, steam starts to curl up, small bubbles shake the lid.

steps.caption: The shelf has a half bag of rice, one sad tea bag and a packet of noodles. One.
steps.move: Cupboard door swings open, camera nudges in on a single noodle packet.

steps.caption: Noodles. Masala flavour. Two minutes and you are a person again.
steps.move: Packet tears, noodles drop into the pot, steam fills the frame, the hunger bar fills as the pot empties.

steps.caption: Your roommate is standing there with the empty wrapper. "Sorry, I was going to replace it."
steps.move: Cupboard is empty, roommate steps into frame holding the wrapper and a sheepish grin, packet crumples in hand.
steps.after: You eat dry bread. It is a decision.

steps.caption: Bag, student card, charger. In that order, because panic has an order.
steps.move: Character slings bag on, pats pockets, picks up the student card from the desk.

steps.caption: Door, stairwell, sunshine. The whole block smells of toast and ambition.
steps.move: Character walks out the door, stairwell passes, camera pulls out onto the path with other students heading the same way.

steps.caption: Past the res gate and the vendors setting up. Someone says "Morning, sisi" and means it.
steps.move: Character walks the path to the bus stop, vendor umbrellas open, a dog trots across the road.

steps.caption: 08:05. A small queue. Everyone checks their phone and pretends not to look at the road.
steps.move: Queue shuffles, people lean to look down the road, shadow of the shelter slides slowly across the ground.

steps.caption: Here it comes, wheezing like it has done this a thousand times. It has.
steps.move: Bus rolls in from the left, brakes hiss, doors fold open, queue surges forward.

steps.caption: Window seat, bag on your knees, 08:20. The campus slides past the glass.
steps.move: Bus pulls away, scenery scrolls past the window, a student dozes with their head on the glass.
steps.sound: Engine hum, a speaker playing amapiano from three seats back.

steps.caption: The bus coughs and stops at a red robot. You watch 08:45 go by.
steps.move: Bus stalls in traffic, clock ticks forward on screen, character taps their foot.

steps.caption: 08:42. Campus. You have eighteen minutes and you are, miraculously, early.
steps.move: Bus doors open, character steps off, camera tilts up to the buildings, students stream toward the lecture venues.

steps.caption: 09:04. You slide into the back row as the lecturer looks up. Nobody says a word. Everybody noticed.
steps.move: Character runs the last stretch, door swings, heads turn together.

tap_feedback: Footsteps trail behind you for a second.
Your bag bounces against your back.
A taxi hoots like it has an opinion.
